spans.s:
m. (-वः)
1 Being, existing, the self-support of something already produced.
2

Birth.
3

Origin, production.
4 The place or means of being.
5 The state of being.
6 The being or becoming possessed of any thing, as family, cattle, &c.
7 Welfare, prosperity.
8 Obtaining, acquisition.
9 Excellence, superiority.
10 The world.
11 A deity, a god.
12 A name of ŚIVA.
n. (-वं)
A fruit, the fruit of the Dillenia speciosa.
E.
भू to be, aff. अच्.

m. (-वः)
1 State or condition of being.
2 Natural state of being, innate property, disposition, nature.
3 Meaning, purpose, intention.
4 Mind, soul.
5 State or affection of mind, emotion, passion, sentiment, especially as an object of amatory and dramatic poetry; two kinds of Bhāvas are usually enumerated, the Sthāyi, and Vyabhicārī; the first of which comprehends eight varieties, and the second thirty-three; the list blends both feelings and effects, and sorrow, and sleep, and passion, and death, &c. are equally classed amongst the Bhāvas; dramatic writers add two other classes, the Vibhāvas or preceding states of mind, leading to a particular condition of mind or body, and Anubhāvas the external signs of any state of mind.
6

Birth.
7

Act, action.
8 Movement, gesture.
9 Wanton sport or pastime.
10 Corporeal expression of amorous sentiments; or love, of which the origin and effects are ascribed to the organs of the body.
11 Thing, substance.
12 A being, a living thing.
13 The place of birth, or pudendum muliebre.
14 Superhuman power.
15 The abstract idea conveyed by any word.
16 The simple idea derived from the root, as expressed in one class of derivatives, as a going, a doing, &c.
17 Advice, instruction.
18 A learned man, a Paṇḍita, (in theatrical language; but especially applied to the manager, or principal performer.)
19 Venerable, respectable.
20 The world, the universe.
21 An organ of sense or passion.
E.
भू to be, aff. घञ्.

m. (-रः)
Fire in a forest.
E.
भव being, घस्मर voracious.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Thou; but used as a respectful term of address, as Sir or Lord, and governing the verb in the third person.
E.
भा to shine, डवतुप Uṇādi aff.
mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Being, existing.
f. (-न्ती)
A poisoned arrow.
E.
भृ to be, participial aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Yours, your honour's.
E.
भवत् as above, and छ aff.

mfn. (-द्भीः-द्भिः-द्भि)
Afraid.
E.
भवत् being, and भी fear.

n. (-नं)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 A nature, a quality.
3 The place of abiding or being, site, field, spot, &c.
E.
भू to be, aff. ल्युट्.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Mental perception, recollection, the present consciousness of past ideas or perceptions.
2

Imagination.
3

Religious and abstract meditation.
4 Looking about, (literally or figuratively,) observing, investigating.
5 Causing to be.
6 Decorating any person or object with flowers, perfume, &c., scenting, anointing.
7 Steeping, infusion, especially repeatedly drying the article by day and keeping it moist at night.
8 (In arithmetic,)

Composition.
9

(In law,) Ascertainment, proof.
E.
भू to be, in the causal form, to bring present or into being, aff. युच्.

f. (-नी)
The Seryu or Serju river, which runs from the Himāla chain and falls into the Goggrah, with which it is then confounded.
E.
भव being, and नाशिनी destructress; giving eternal happiness, being a sacred stream.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be or become, what is or ought to be.
E.
भू to be, अनीयर् aff. of the gerund.

n. (-रं)
The interior apartments.
E.
भवन, and उदर belly.

m. (-न्तः)
Time in general, or time present.
f. (-न्ती)
A virtuous wife.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. झच्.

m. (-न्तिः)
Time being, the present.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. झिच्.

mfn. (-क्)
Living, sharing the world.
E.
भव, and भाज् who possesses.

m. (-तिः)
The author of MĀLATĪMĀDHAVA, and other dramas.
E.
भव the world, भूति increase, in wisdom, &c.

f. (-रुद् or -रुत्)
A drum played at funerals.
E.
भव being, रुद् to weep or wail, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-तिः)
1 Liberation from the world, cessation from worldly acts.
2 End of the world.
E.
भव, and वीति passing away.

f. (-जा)
The goddess MANASĀ.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Like you, your like.
E.
भवत् you, दृश् to shew, aff. क्विप्; also भवादृश, and भवादृक्ष.

f. (-नी)
The goddess PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ, in her pacific and amiable form.
E.
भव ŚIVA, fem. aff. ङीप्, and आनुक् augment.

m. (-रुः)
The personified Himālaya mountain.
E.
भवानी the goddess, and गुरु here put for father: DURGĀ in this form being the daughter of the mountain.

m. (-वः)
1 Non-existence of the world.
2 A sage, one unaffected by worldly infirmities.
E.
भव, and अभाव nonexistence.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Superior to or overcoming the world.
E.
भव, and अभिभाविन् disgracing.

f. (-ना)
The Ganges.
E.
भव the world, and अयन going.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Prosperous, happy, welfaring.
n. (-कं)
Prosperity, welfare.
E.
भव being, (for well being,) and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
1 Natural, innate.
2 Sentimental, relating to feeling, &c.
3 Future.
n. (-कं)
A figure of rhetoric, describing the past or future as present.
E.
भाव, and ठक् aff., or भू to be, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Been, become.
E.
भव being, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Occupied with, pervaded by, having as an inherent or pervading property.
2 Animated, inspired.
3 Imagined, conceived.
4 Perfumed, scented.
5 Mixed, (with any thing as an ingredient, as asafoetida or other fragrant substances in curry, &c.)
6 Obtained, got.
7 Promised, agreed, acknowledged.
8 Steeped, infused, digested, &c.
9 (In arithmetic,) Supposed, as the product of unknown quantities.
E.
भू to be, passive or causal v., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be or become, what is to be.
E.
भू to be, तव्य aff. of the gerund.

f. (-ता)
Fate, destiny.
E.
भवितव्य what is to be, तल् abstract aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Actually being, or disposed to be.
2 Wellbeing, faring well.
E.
भू to be, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living, being, having life and sensation.
E.
भव being, इनि aff.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Future, what will be or what is about to be, proximately future.
f. (-नी)
A wanton woman.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. णिनि.

m. (-नः)
A poet, a versifier.
E.
भव the world, इनन् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Being, existing, what is or exists.
m. (-लः)
A catamite.
E.
भू to be, इलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Actually being or disposed to be.
2 Being well, existing happily, virtuously, &c.
E.
भू to be, इष्णुच् participial aff.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Future, what will be.
E.
see भविष्यत्, the final rejected.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
What is to be, what will be, future.
n. (-ष्यत्)
The future.
E.
भू to be, शतृ participial aff., स्य augment, and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Happy, auspicious, prosperous.
2 Well, proper, fit, right.
3

True.
4

To be or become, what is to be.
5 A being, what is or exists.
m. (-व्यः)
The Kāmaraṅga, a small fruit tree, (Averhoa carambola.)
f. (-व्या)
1 A name of

UMĀ.
2

A large sort of pepper.
n. (-व्यं)
1 A bone.
2 Fruit, result.
3 Being, existence.
mn. (-व्यः-व्यं)
One division of the poetical Rasas or sentiments.
E.
भू to be, aff. यत्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 What must, will, or ought to be.
2 To be investigated or determined.
E.
भू to be, aff. ण्यत्.

m. (-कः)
The external expression of amatory sentiments.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-जः)
Love, KĀMA.
E.
भाव sentiment, and ज produced.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Yours, your honour's.
E.
भवत् you, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Yours, (but used respectfully,) your honour's.
E.
भवत् you, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
The sign or indication of any sentiment or passion.
E.
भाव sentiment, and बोधक what indicates.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Fancying, imagining, calling to mind.
E.
भू to be, causal v., शतृ aff.

f. (-ता)
Co-existence of various emotions.
E.
भाव, and शवलता variety of colour.

f. (-न्तिः)
Allaying, any transitory or incidental emotion.
E.
भाव, and शान्ति quieting.

f. (-द्धिः)
Purification of the natural condition or quality.
E.
भाव, and संशुद्धि purification.

m. (-न्धिः)
Co-existence of two emotions.
E.
भाव, and सन्धि union.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Of restrained purpose or thought, abstracted, devout.
E.
भाव, and समाहित collected.

m. (-टः)
1 The external expression or indication of amatory feeling.
2 A pious or holy man.
3 An actor.
4 A libidinous man.
5 Dress, decoration.
E.
भाव the sentiment or disposition, अट to go with, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Natural, simple, not forced or assumed.
E.
भाव, and अनुग according to.

m. (-सः)
Simulation of feeling or emotion.
E.
भाव, and आभास appearance.

m. (-र्थः)
1 The simple inherent or abstract meaning of words.
2 The obvious purport of a phrase or sentence.
E.
भाव, and अर्थ sense.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Tender, compassionate.
E.
भाव, and अव what preserves.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Imagining, conceiving.
2 Infusing, &c.
E.
भू to be, causal v., क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Intent upon, engaged in.
E.
भावित pervaded, आत्मन् spirit.

n. (-त्रं)
The three worlds: earth, heaven, and hell, collectively.
E.
भू to exist, णित्रन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-यः)
Accession or occurrence of emotions.
E.
भवा, उदय rising.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Happy, well, right.
2 Actually being or disposed to be.
3 (In composition with other nouns,) Becoming what it was not before, as आढ्यंभावुक one who becomes rich.
n. (-कं)
Happiness, auspiciousness.
m. (-कः)
A sister's husband, (in theatrical language.)
E.
भू to be, aff. उकञ्; used in composition, the aff. is खुकञ्.
